brief.disclaimer: Entirely fictional. 'Lumen' and 'Nova 2' are invented for this demo and do not describe any real company or product.
brief.summary: Nova 2 is a new multimodal model powering the Lumen assistant app. Launch includes a press announcement, an early access creator program, assistant app rollout in 14 regions, and a browser integration.
facts: Press announcement and blog post go live when the embargo lifts at 09:00 PT on launch day.
Early access creator program is planned to open 2027-02-01 with ~200 creators under NDA.
Red team sign-off is currently scheduled for 2027-02-08.
Legal review of all performance and safety claims takes 10 business days from submission.
Marketing copy lock is 5 calendar days before launch.
Regional teams publish at 09:00 local time on launch day across 14 regions, including Japan (JST, UTC+9) and Australia (AEDT, UTC+11).
The browser integration is expected to ship 2027-03-17, one week after launch.
The press release draft says the assistant is 'available in the browser today'.
Localized safety disclaimers need Legal-approved wording before translation starts. No Regional owner is assigned for this yet.

milestones.name: Program kickoff
milestones.note: All four workstreams (PR, Product, Regional, Legal) start.

milestones.name: Early access creator program opens (~200 creators, NDA)
milestones.note: TENSION: opens 7 days before red team sign-off (2027-02-08). Creators get access to a model that has not cleared red team. Decide whether to move opening to on or after 02-08 or to accept the risk.

milestones.name: Red team sign-off
milestones.note: Scheduled date per brief. Legal submission depends on its results.

milestones.name: Legal submission of performance and safety claims
milestones.note: Starts the 10-business-day review. Latest submission that still clears before copy lock is 2027-02-19.

milestones.name: Assign Regional owner for localized safety disclaimers
milestones.note: GAP: no owner is assigned today. Must be named before Legal approval so translation can start on time.

milestones.name: Legal approval of claims and safety disclaimer wording
milestones.note: 10 business days from the 02-09 submission, not counting holidays such as US Presidents' Day on 02-15, which could push this to 02-24. Translation cannot start before this.

milestones.name: Translation of localized safety disclaimers starts
milestones.note: Blocked until Legal-approved wording exists. Roughly 10 days remain before copy lock for 14 regions.

milestones.name: Fix press release draft: remove 'available in the browser today'
milestones.note: TENSION: browser integration ships 2027-03-17, a week after launch, so the claim is false at launch. Reword to 'coming March 17', or pull the ship date forward. Must be resolved before copy lock.

milestones.name: Marketing copy lock
milestones.note: 5 calendar days before launch. All copy must use Legal-approved claims and the corrected browser wording.

milestones.name: Regional publish: Australia (AEDT, UTC+11), 09:00 local
milestones.note: TENSION: 09:00 AEDT on 03-10 is 14:00 PT on 03-09, about 19 hours before the 09:00 PT embargo lift. Publishing at local time breaks the embargo. Needs a decision: hold until the embargo lifts, or move the embargo.

milestones.name: Regional publish: Japan (JST, UTC+9), 09:00 local
milestones.note: TENSION: 09:00 JST on 03-10 is 16:00 PT on 03-09, about 17 hours before the embargo lift. Same decision as Australia. The other 12 regions publish at 09:00 local on 03-10, with times to be checked against the embargo.

milestones.name: Embargo lifts: press announcement and blog post live
milestones.note: 09:00 PT (2027-03-10T09:00:00-08:00). Launch day, assistant app rollout in 14 regions.

milestones.name: Browser integration ships
milestones.note: One week after launch. Launch-day messaging must not claim browser availability.

risks.title: Regional 09:00-local publishing breaks the 09:00 PT embargo, starting with Australia and Japan and likely affecting most of the 14 regions
risks.evidence: The embargo lifts 2027-03-10T09:00-08:00 (17:00 UTC). US DST does not start until 03-14, so PT is UTC-8. The Australia milestone is 09:00 AEDT on 03-10, which is 22:00 UTC / 14:00 PT on 03-09, 19h early. The Japan milestone is 09:00 JST on 03-10, which is 00:00 UTC / 16:00 PT on 03-09, 17h early. 09:00 local in any time zone east of PT falls before 09:00 PT. So the 'other 12 regions' that the schedule leaves 'to be checked' will also break the embargo unless they are at UTC-8 or further west. Example: 09:00 GMT is 01:00 PT. REG-6 executes publishing on 03-10 with no time guard.
risks.mitigation: Make one decision by 2027-02-12 and pick one of two options. (a) Hold all regional publishing until 17:00 UTC on 03-10, which is 04:00 AEDT and 02:00 JST on 03-11. (b) Move the global embargo earlier, for example to 2027-03-09T14:00-08:00, so APAC 09:00 local on 03-10 is compliant, and re-brief media. Then publish a per-region UTC/PT schedule for all 14 regions. Add a publish-time check to the REG-5 checklists and the creator NDA guidance (PR-2).
risks.owner: PR lead (decision), with Regional lead executing the per-region schedule

risks.title: Early access creator program opens to ~200 creators before red team sign-off
risks.evidence: The schedule still shows the creator program opening 2027-02-01, 7 days before red team sign-off on 2027-02-08. The plans disagree with it: PRO-3 is due 02-08 and depends on PRO-2 (red team). LEG-1 (due 01-29) adds 'pre-red-team-model risk disclosure', and PR-2 (due 01-28) drafts comms for either outcome. The PRO-1 decision is due 01-22, but the PR ask is dated 01-25, so the dates are inconsistent. Two outcomes are possible: external users get an un-cleared model, or the schedule and comms announce the wrong date.
risks.mitigation: Product decides by 01-22 (PRO-1) and records the decision in the master schedule. Recommended: open on or after a passed red team sign-off (no earlier than 02-09). If Product instead accepts the risk, it needs written sign-off from the Product exec and Legal, LEG-1 disclosure language, and usage limits. Align PR-2 and LEG-1 to the chosen date by 01-25.

risks.title: Every task in all four workstreams has owner 'TBD', including the unassigned localized safety disclaimer owner
risks.evidence: All 24 tasks (PR-1 to PR-6, PRO-1 to PRO-6, REG-1 to REG-6, LEG-1 to LEG-6) list owner 'TBD'. The brief states 'No Regional owner is assigned' for localized safety disclaimers. REG-1, due 02-12, is itself unowned, and REG-3 (translation start 02-23) depends on it. Early tasks are due within 2 weeks of the 01-11 kickoff: PRO-1 on 01-22, PR-2 on 01-28, LEG-1 on 01-29.
risks.mitigation: At or immediately after kickoff (by 2027-01-15), each workstream lead names an individual owner for every task. Bring the date for naming the disclaimer translation owner forward from 02-12 to 01-22 so vendor capacity for 14 regions can be booked before Legal approval. The program manager tracks owner coverage in the weekly review.
risks.owner: Program manager, with each workstream lead

risks.title: Claims review and translation chain has no buffer: red team, Legal approval, 14-region translation and copy lock are back-to-back
risks.evidence:
The chain runs as follows:
- Red team sign-off on 02-08 (Mon) is followed by Legal submission on 02-09 (Tue) with zero buffer.
- LEG-2 (substantiation package) is due 02-08, the same day as red team. It depends on LEG-1 (NDA), not PRO-2, so red team findings cannot be reflected.
- 10 business days from 02-09, excluding Presidents' Day 02-15, lands on 02-24 (Wed), not 02-23.
- That leaves 8 business days (02-24 to 03-05) for translation of 14 regions plus REG-4 in-region review before copy lock.
- The schedule's 'latest submission 02-19' would yield approval on 03-05, the copy lock day itself, leaving zero translation time.
- REG-3 depends only on REG-1, not LEG-4, so translation could start on unapproved wording.
- No task has Legal review the translated disclaimers.
risks.mitigation: Re-baseline Legal approval to 02-24 and remove the misleading '02-19 latest' note. The real latest submission is about 02-09. Have Legal pre-review safety disclaimer wording before red team, since it is less dependent on red team results, and submit it around 02-01 so translation can start around 02-16. Make LEG-2 depend on PRO-2 and REG-3 depend on LEG-4. Add a Legal spot-check task for translated disclaimers by 03-04. Pre-book translation vendors for 14 regions with a rush option.
risks.owner: Legal lead, with Regional disclaimer owner

risks.title: False 'available in the browser today' claim could survive into launch copy due to late fix and missing dependencies
risks.evidence:
The press release draft says 'available in the browser today', but the browser ships 2027-03-17 (PRO-6), a week after the 03-10 launch.
- The fix (PR-4) is not due until 03-03, while PR-3 submits draft claims to Legal on 02-09, possibly with the false claim.
- LEG-5 re-review is due 03-04 but depends only on LEG-4, not PR-4.
- PR-5 copy lock (03-05) does not depend on LEG-5, so copy can lock without Legal confirming the fix.
- REG-4 (localized press copy, due 03-05) depends only on REG-3, not PR-4. Regional receives corrected English copy on 03-03, leaving 2 days to localize and review 14 regions.
- The replacement 'coming March 17' becomes false again if PRO-6 slips.
risks.mitigation: Remove the browser claim from the draft now and before the 02-09 Legal submission, not on 03-03. Use 'coming soon' or 'coming next week' unless Product commits in writing (PRO-4, moved earlier) to 03-17. Add dependencies: PR-5 on LEG-5, LEG-5 on PR-4, and REG-4 on PR-4 and LEG-4. Deliver final English copy to Regional by 02-26.

risks.title: Embargo decision has conflicting deadlines and owners, and Legal's embargo advice arrives after the decision
risks.evidence:
The same decision has four different dates:
- PR-1 decides by 02-12, and PR's ask to Regional is dated 02-12.
- REG-2 decides by 02-19, and Regional's ask to PR is dated 02-19.
- Product's ask to PR is dated 02-19.
- LEG-6 (legal and contractual embargo obligations) is due 02-26 and depends on LEG-4 (claims approval), which is unrelated. Its advice therefore comes 1-2 weeks after the decision.
Both PR-1 and REG-2 claim the decision, and both have owner TBD.
risks.mitigation: Assign a single decision owner (PR) with Regional and Legal as consulted parties, and set one deadline of 02-12. Remove LEG-6's dependency on LEG-4 and move it to 02-10 so legal advice informs the decision. Communicate the outcome to Product for in-product timing (PRO-5).

risks.title: Unclear who prepares and submits the performance/safety claims package to Legal
risks.evidence: PR-3 says PR submits claims to Legal by 02-09. LEG-3 says Legal 'submit[s]...to Legal review' on 02-09. Product and Regional both ask Legal to submit. Legal asks Product to 'provide the claims list with supporting evidence' by 02-09, but no Product task covers that; PRO-2 only shares red team results. Three teams assume another is assembling the package, all due 02-09, the day after red team.
risks.mitigation:
Define a RACI by 01-22:
- PR authors the claims list (from the drafts).
- Product supplies evidence and red team results (add a PRO task due 02-08).
- Legal receives and reviews.
Rewrite LEG-3 as 'receive submission and start 10-business-day clock'.

risks.title: No task covers executing or timing the 14-region assistant app rollout against the embargo
risks.evidence: The brief says the launch includes 'assistant app rollout in 14 regions'. Product's ask to Regional asks to 'confirm 14-region in-app rollout timing against the 09:00 PT embargo', but no task covers this. REG-2 covers press and social publish timing only, and PRO-5 only finalizes the availability list. No PRO or REG task executes the rollout on 03-10. A rollout at local time in APAC would expose Nova 2 about 17-19h before the embargo.
risks.mitigation: Add a Product task (due 02-26) for the per-region rollout plan, gated to the R1 embargo decision. Add a 03-10 execution task with a kill switch and monitoring, owned jointly with Regional.

risks.title: Cross-team asks with mismatched dates or no matching task
risks.evidence:
Three asks have no matching task or a later date:
- Regional asks Product to confirm the browser ship date by 02-08, but PRO-4 is due 02-26. PR's matching ask is dated 03-01.
- Regional asks PR to share final English copy for localization by 03-03, but no PR task covers the handoff. PR-4 only fixes the draft.
- Regional's ask to Legal to 'submit claims' duplicates PR-3 and LEG-3.
risks.mitigation: Move PRO-4 to 02-12 so Regional and PR plan with a confirmed date. Add a PR task 'hand off final English copy to Regional' due 02-26. Close the duplicate submission asks once the R7 RACI is set.

(b) Move the global embargo earlier, for example to 2027-03-09T14:00-08:00, so APAC 09:00 local on 03-10 is compliant, and re-brief media. Then publish a per-region UTC/PT schedule for all 14 regions. Add a publish-time check to the REG-5 checklists and the creator NDA guidance (PR-2).
risks.owner: PR lead (decision), with Regional lead executing the per-region schedule

risks.title: Early access creator program opens to ~200 creators before red team sign-off
risks.evidence: The schedule still shows the creator program opening 2027-02-01, 7 days before red team sign-off on 2027-02-08. The plans disagree with it: PRO-3 is due 02-08 and depends on PRO-2 (red team). LEG-1 (due 01-29) adds 'pre-red-team-model risk disclosure', and PR-2 (due 01-28) drafts comms for either outcome. The PRO-1 decision is due 01-22, but the PR ask is dated 01-25, so the dates are inconsistent. Two outcomes are possible: external users get an un-cleared model, or the schedule and comms announce the wrong date.
risks.mitigation: Product decides by 01-22 (PRO-1) and records the decision in the master schedule. Recommended: open on or after a passed red team sign-off (no earlier than 02-09). If Product instead accepts the risk, it needs written sign-off from the Product exec and Legal, LEG-1 disclosure language, and usage limits. Align PR-2 and LEG-1 to the chosen date by 01-25.

risks.title: Every task in all four workstreams has owner 'TBD', including the unassigned localized safety disclaimer owner
risks.evidence: All 24 tasks (PR-1 to PR-6, PRO-1 to PRO-6, REG-1 to REG-6, LEG-1 to LEG-6) list owner 'TBD'. The brief states 'No Regional owner is assigned' for localized safety disclaimers. REG-1, due 02-12, is itself unowned, and REG-3 (translation start 02-23) depends on it. Early tasks are due within 2 weeks of the 01-11 kickoff: PRO-1 on 01-22, PR-2 on 01-28, LEG-1 on 01-29.
risks.mitigation: At or immediately after kickoff (by 2027-01-15), each workstream lead names an individual owner for every task. Bring the date for naming the disclaimer translation owner forward from 02-12 to 01-22 so vendor capacity for 14 regions can be booked before Legal approval. The program manager tracks owner coverage in the weekly review.
risks.owner: Program manager, with each workstream lead

risks.title: Claims review and translation chain has no buffer: red team, Legal approval, 14-region translation and copy lock are back-to-back
risks.evidence:
The chain runs as follows:
- Red team sign-off on 02-08 (Mon) is followed by Legal submission on 02-09 (Tue) with zero buffer.
- LEG-2 (substantiation package) is due 02-08, the same day as red team. It depends on LEG-1 (NDA), not PRO-2, so red team findings cannot be reflected.
- 10 business days from 02-09, excluding Presidents' Day 02-15, lands on 02-24 (Wed), not 02-23.
- That leaves 8 business days (02-24 to 03-05) for translation of 14 regions plus REG-4 in-region review before copy lock.
- The schedule's 'latest submission 02-19' would yield approval on 03-05, the copy lock day itself, leaving zero translation time.
- REG-3 depends only on REG-1, not LEG-4, so translation could start on unapproved wording.
- No task has Legal review the translated disclaimers.
risks.mitigation: Re-baseline Legal approval to 02-24 and remove the misleading '02-19 latest' note. The real latest submission is about 02-09. Have Legal pre-review safety disclaimer wording before red team, since it is less dependent on red team results, and submit it around 02-01 so translation can start around 02-16. Make LEG-2 depend on PRO-2 and REG-3 depend on LEG-4. Add a Legal spot-check task for translated disclaimers by 03-04. Pre-book translation vendors for 14 regions with a rush option.
risks.owner: Legal lead, with Regional disclaimer owner

risks.title: False 'available in the browser today' claim could survive into launch copy due to late fix and missing dependencies
risks.evidence:
The press release draft says 'available in the browser today', but the browser ships 2027-03-17 (PRO-6), a week after the 03-10 launch.
- The fix (PR-4) is not due until 03-03, while PR-3 submits draft claims to Legal on 02-09, possibly with the false claim.
- LEG-5 re-review is due 03-04 but depends only on LEG-4, not PR-4.
- PR-5 copy lock (03-05) does not depend on LEG-5, so copy can lock without Legal confirming the fix.
- REG-4 (localized press copy, due 03-05) depends only on REG-3, not PR-4. Regional receives corrected English copy on 03-03, leaving 2 days to localize and review 14 regions.
- The replacement 'coming March 17' becomes false again if PRO-6 slips.
risks.mitigation: Remove the browser claim from the draft now and before the 02-09 Legal submission, not on 03-03. Use 'coming soon' or 'coming next week' unless Product commits in writing (PRO-4, moved earlier) to 03-17. Add dependencies: PR-5 on LEG-5, LEG-5 on PR-4, and REG-4 on PR-4 and LEG-4. Deliver final English copy to Regional by 02-26.

risks.title: Embargo decision has conflicting deadlines and owners, and Legal's embargo advice arrives after the decision
risks.evidence:
The same decision has four different dates:
- PR-1 decides by 02-12, and PR's ask to Regional is dated 02-12.
- REG-2 decides by 02-19, and Regional's ask to PR is dated 02-19.
- Product's ask to PR is dated 02-19.
- LEG-6 (legal and contractual embargo obligations) is due 02-26 and depends on LEG-4 (claims approval), which is unrelated. Its advice therefore comes 1-2 weeks after the decision.
Both PR-1 and REG-2 claim the decision, and both have owner TBD.
risks.mitigation: Assign a single decision owner (PR) with Regional and Legal as consulted parties, and set one deadline of 02-12. Remove LEG-6's dependency on LEG-4 and move it to 02-10 so legal advice informs the decision. Communicate the outcome to Product for in-product timing (PRO-5).

risks.title: Unclear who prepares and submits the performance/safety claims package to Legal
risks.evidence: PR-3 says PR submits claims to Legal by 02-09. LEG-3 says Legal 'submit[s]...to Legal review' on 02-09. Product and Regional both ask Legal to submit. Legal asks Product to 'provide the claims list with supporting evidence' by 02-09, but no Product task covers that; PRO-2 only shares red team results. Three teams assume another is assembling the package, all due 02-09, the day after red team.
risks.mitigation:
Define a RACI by 01-22:
- PR authors the claims list (from the drafts).
- Product supplies evidence and red team results (add a PRO task due 02-08).
- Legal receives and reviews.
Rewrite LEG-3 as 'receive submission and start 10-business-day clock'.

risks.title: No task covers executing or timing the 14-region assistant app rollout against the embargo
risks.evidence: The brief says the launch includes 'assistant app rollout in 14 regions'. Product's ask to Regional asks to 'confirm 14-region in-app rollout timing against the 09:00 PT embargo', but no task covers this. REG-2 covers press and social publish timing only, and PRO-5 only finalizes the availability list. No PRO or REG task executes the rollout on 03-10. A rollout at local time in APAC would expose Nova 2 about 17-19h before the embargo.
risks.mitigation: Add a Product task (due 02-26) for the per-region rollout plan, gated to the R1 embargo decision. Add a 03-10 execution task with a kill switch and monitoring, owned jointly with Regional.

risks.title: Cross-team asks with mismatched dates or no matching task
risks.evidence:
Three asks have no matching task or a later date:
- Regional asks Product to confirm the browser ship date by 02-08, but PRO-4 is due 02-26. PR's matching ask is dated 03-01.
- Regional asks PR to share final English copy for localization by 03-03, but no PR task covers the handoff. PR-4 only fixes the draft.
- Regional's ask to Legal to 'submit claims' duplicates PR-3 and LEG-3.
risks.mitigation: Move PRO-4 to 02-12 so Regional and PR plan with a confirmed date. Add a PR task 'hand off final English copy to Regional' due 02-26. Close the duplicate submission asks once the R7 RACI is set.
